title: Quality Parameter of Produce — Onion
organization: Small Farmers’ Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC), Government of India
description: A produce-quality reference that describes preferred onion diameter and visible selection/rejection characteristics. The 40–65 mm preference is treated here as a contextual reference, not as a universal tender specification.

title: Procedure for Grant of AGMARK — Grading of Onion for Export to the European Union
organization: Directorate of Marketing & Inspection / APEDA; hosted by Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
description: An archival 2006 document describing AGMARK onion inspection and quality parameters for export. Confirm the current applicable rules with the relevant authority before procurement use.

title: Onions (Other Than Bermuda-Granex-Grano and Creole Type): Grades and Standards
description: Official U.S. grade requirements and size provisions. Included for computer-vision feature context only; it is not an Indian procurement rule.

title: Onion Inspection Instructions
type: Official inspection guidance (United States; comparative reference)
description: Inspection guidance discussing onion condition, defects, and size reporting. The document is jurisdiction-specific and is not applied by the default PYAazScan rules.

title: Preharvest production practices, and postharvest treatment and handling methods for best quality onion bulbs: review
description: Review of onion production and postharvest handling, including visible sprouting and decay as quality and storage concerns. Access to the full paper may depend on the publisher.

title: Onion image classification using CNN models
organization: ICTACT Journal on Image and Video Processing
description: A recent image-classification study. Its reported results depend on its own dataset and protocol and are not measurements of PYAazScan.
